scope.multi_view_policy: Every selected lesion carries all available views in lexicographic case_id order; all arms receive the identical ordered view set and frozen lesion-level perception output.
scope.bcn_scc_policy: SCC remains explicit. It is excluded from shared-seven multiclass metrics and retained in actionable-binary metrics. BCN is development sensitivity evidence because it was previously inspected.

paper_claims_under_test.claim: A typed multimodal EvidenceContract makes image support, evidence support, citations, contradiction state, uncertainty, and termination machine-checkable.
paper_claims_under_test.novelty_boundary: The operational contract and its measured completion are the contribution; structured output in general is not.

paper_claims_under_test.claim: Patient-image exemplars plus authoritative text retrieval with cross-modal lineage improve evidence usefulness and traceability over single-pass dense RAG.
paper_claims_under_test.novelty_boundary: Knowledge graphs and provenance alone are not novel and provenance is never treated as truth.

paper_claims_under_test.claim: A transparent bounded hierarchy recovers from typed evidence failures through at most one EXPAND, REFORMULATE, or INDEPENDENT_SOURCE action before PASS or ABSTAIN.
paper_claims_under_test.novelty_boundary: No learned depth-two policy and no HANDOFF are part of this claim.

paper_claims_under_test.claim: Structured verification and immutable receipts expose separate trajectory-trust dimensions instead of one composite trust score.
paper_claims_under_test.novelty_boundary: CATIA/GRiP and NIST AI RMF organize interpretation and governance; the frameworks themselves are not novelty.

paper_claims_under_test.claim: A matched multi-paradigm evaluation jointly reports diagnosis, evidence quality, selective risk, recovery, coverage, and cost.
paper_claims_under_test.novelty_boundary: Published cross-dataset scores are reference bars, not H2H wins.

frozen_dataset_artifacts.role: HAM parent split including sealed test identities
frozen_dataset_artifacts.access: train and calibration allowed; sealed test identities and outcomes prohibited until final authorization
development sensitivity only; not untouched confirmation

development_h2h_manifest_rule.selection: Within each class, order cluster_id by SHA256('20260716:' + cluster_id) and retain min(30, available class lesions). Include every image view for each retained cluster in case_id order.
development_h2h_manifest_rule.purpose: development H2H, implementation debugging, adaptive-slot selection, and ablation; never confirmatory

perception_boundary.selection_status: frozen development choice; not a final-test performance claim
perception_boundary.pending_artifact: One lesion-level prediction/distribution artifact for the 160-case development manifest, shared byte-for-byte by every arm.
perception_boundary.sealed_rule: Sealed-test perception outputs are generated once only after all components are frozen and sealed access is authorized.
perception_boundary.not_part_of_main_ablation: Perception encoder choice is held fixed. Historical PanDerm/MONET comparisons may be reported as development sensitivity, not as MedGuard component ablations.

adaptive_slot.selection_gate: Select exactly one using implementation fidelity, availability of load-bearing training/components, compatibility with the shared corpus, and feasible matched budget before viewing H2H outputs.
adaptive_slot.dyna_label_rule: The existing GMM-ATKS audit is a DynaRAG component ablation only. Full DynaRAG naming requires QAF, AAM, disclosed training losses, and a faithful generator path.

ablation_matrix.name: without image-exemplar retrieval
ablation_matrix.change_from_A0: Disable image-exemplar evidence retrieval only; retain the identical frozen image/perception input and authoritative text retrieval.

ablation_matrix.name: without graph relations
ablation_matrix.change_from_A0: Disable graph construction, traversal, and lineage edges; retain flat source_id, version, authority, retrieval_path, and content_hash fields.

ablation_matrix.name: without remediation
ablation_matrix.change_from_A0: Disable EXPAND, REFORMULATE, and INDEPENDENT_SOURCE. After one pass, a satisfied contract may PASS and any unresolved failure ABSTAINS.

ablation_matrix.name: without verifier gating
ablation_matrix.change_from_A0: Run and record verification in observe-only mode. Verification cannot trigger repair or abstention; malformed contracts remain generation errors and cannot PASS.
ablation_matrix.isolates: structured verification as a decision gate
ablation_matrix.restriction: offline evaluation only; never a deployment recommendation

ablation_matrix.name: single-pass dense RAG
ablation_matrix.change_from_A0: No EvidenceContract; conventional single-pass answer with the same perception output, text corpus, generator, decoding, and top-k ceiling.
ablation_matrix.isolates: practical full-system contrast for the evidence-contract architecture
ablation_matrix.metric_rule: evidence_contract_completion is not applicable, not zero

optional_action_ablation_rule.eligibility: A0 must trigger the action on at least 30 distinct development lesions before outcomes are viewed.
optional_action_ablation_rule.implementation: Disable one eligible action at a time and fail to ABSTAIN when that typed failure cannot be repaired.
optional_action_ablation_rule.reporting: secondary only; strata below 30 are descriptive

failure_typed_suite.minimum_for_inference: 30 distinct development lesion clusters in each of F1-F4
failure_typed_suite.purpose: measure routing appropriateness, recovery, termination, coverage, and cost; not attack-defense efficacy, prevalence, or clinical harm
failure_typed_suite.construction_rule: Use only test-redacted development identities and freeze the typed failure before running method outputs.

endpoints.evidence_superiority_rule: Against the strongest compatible primary rival, the 95% lesion-clustered paired interval must exclude zero for at least two prespecified evidence/process endpoints while macro-F1 and accuracy satisfy noninferiority.

statistics.ablation_effect: paired A0-minus-ablation difference for each compatible endpoint
statistics.missing_scores: explicit count and reason; no silent deletion
statistics.multiplicity: Holm correction within each prespecified endpoint family when more than one comparison is inferential

artifact_freeze_ledger.artifact: text and exemplar indexes rebuilt from the frozen corpus/case pool
source policy and citation identifier registry
generator, prompts, decoding, seeds, retries, call/token budget
RAGAS judge and evidence scorer versions
source-tree revision or deterministic source receipt
